errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите, представляващи различни икономически сектори
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis contains the categories. In this horizontal bar chart, the categories (economic sectors) are listed on the vertical axis.
The description claims the categories are arranged in random order, but they are clearly sorted in ascending order of their corresponding percentage values, from top to bottom.
The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis represents the percentages. The percentages correspond to the length of the horizontal bars and are represented on the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: чиято скала е линейна и варира от 0% до 85%, като числата са разположени на интервали от 5%
errors.evidence: The description invents details for the value axis, stating that it has a scale from 0% to 85% with 5% intervals. The chart does not have a visible axis line with ticks or numerical labels; it only shows data labels next to each bar.
